journey.title: Plan from Explore
journey.purpose: Fill an empty week slot from Explore: the slot becomes explicit context, a suggestion with a reason is added to that slot only, and the week shows the new occurrence.

steps.intent: Choose Add dinner on an empty Wednesday slot.
See Planning Wednesday dinner and suggestions that fit, each with a reason.
See the new occurrence on Wednesday and a recipe snapshot in the collection.

claims.statement: Adding from Explore creates exactly one occurrence in the context slot and replaces nothing.
Retrying the add or save does not create a duplicate meal or occurrence.
